name: pr
porting_notes: Port of OpenBSD pr 1.46. Uses a custom egetopt() parser for pr's extended option syntax (+page, -column). Fixed two memory leaks: ferrout linked list (vasprintf'd error message nodes never freed) and indy index array (calloc'd column index). Both fixed in atexit cleanup handler. Signal handler uses _exit(10) for safest exit path on AmigaOS. amiport_stat() for file timestamps in page headers. 32/32 FS-UAE tests pass.
known_limitations: Terminal width detection uses hardcoded 72-column default; use -w to override. Form feed (0x0C) renders as blank lines on AmigaOS console rather than page ejects. SIGINT handling approximate due to AmigaOS signal delivery differences from POSIX.

pr - Print files for page display

Original author: The Regents of the University of California
Ported by Duncan Bowring using amiport (AI-assisted porting toolkit).
Project: https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport

Cross-compiled with m68k-amigaos-gcc for AmigaOS 3.x (68000+).
Tested in vamos emulator and FS-UAE.

Usage:
  pr [+page] [-column] [-adFfmprt] [-e [char] [gap]]
     [-h header] [-i [char] [gap]] [-l lines]
     [-n [char] [width]] [-o offset] [-s [char]]
     [-w width] [file ...]

Paginate and format text files for printing or display.
Supports multi-column output, custom headers, page numbering,
line numbering, and parallel file display.

Includes full source code (original POSIX and ported Amiga versions)
and PORT.md documenting every transformation applied.
